description: The title, registration, plate and other state fees each pilot state charges when a Florida, Texas or North Carolina resident buys a passenger car or light truck from a dealer in their own state (ticket 139). Each amount was read in the official text on checkedOn and is reviewed again by reviewOn; after reviewOn the schedule is not used. A changed amount is a new version. Ranges run from the least the fee can be to the most, and dependsOn names the fact that decides it. maxMinor null means the fee has no upper bound this schedule can state.

states.name: Florida
states.scope: A Florida resident buying a private-use automobile, or a truck of 5,000 pounds or less, from a Florida dealer. Heavy trucks, specialty and personalized plates, leases and vehicles registered outside Florida are not covered.
states.note: A Florida tax collector or private tag agency may add its own service charges, which it must itemize (F.S. 319.32(2)(c) and 320.04(3)). They are not in this schedule.

fees.name: Certificate of title
fees.purpose: Puts the car's ownership in your name in the state's records.
fees.dependsOn: whether the car is new, already titled in Florida, or last titled in another state
fees.citation: FLHSMV fee schedule, https://www.flhsmv.gov/motor-vehicles-tags-titles/fees/ (Original New $77.25, Original Used $85.25, Transfer $75.25, electronic titles); F.S. 319.32(1), (2)(a) and (3) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/319.32

fees.name: Lien recording
fees.purpose: Records your lender on the title when the car is financed.
fees.dependsOn: whether the car is financed
fees.citation: F.S. 319.32(1) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/319.32; FLHSMV fee schedule, https://www.flhsmv.gov/motor-vehicles-tags-titles/fees/

fees.name: Paper title mailing
fees.purpose: Prints and mails a paper title instead of keeping it electronic.
fees.dependsOn: whether a paper title is printed
fees.citation: F.S. 319.32(1) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/319.32; FLHSMV fee schedule, https://www.flhsmv.gov/motor-vehicles-tags-titles/fees/

fees.name: Fast title
fees.purpose: Issues the title the same day, if someone asks for it.
fees.dependsOn: whether a fast title is requested
fees.citation: FLHSMV fee schedule, https://www.flhsmv.gov/motor-vehicles-tags-titles/fees/ (Fast Title $10.00); F.S. 319.32(7) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/319.32

fees.name: Tax collector branch office charge
fees.purpose: An extra charge a county tax collector may add at a branch office.
fees.dependsOn: where the title is processed
fees.citation: F.S. 320.04(1)(c) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/320.04

fees.name: Registration
fees.purpose: The yearly license tax that lets the car use Florida roads, with the small state fees added to every registration.
fees.dependsOn: the car's weight and whether it is registered for 12 or 24 months
fees.citation: F.S. 320.08(2)(b)-(d) and (3)(a)-(c) license tax $14.50, $22.50 or $32.50 by weight; per registration F.S. 320.0801(1) $0.10, 320.0802 $1, 320.0804 $2, 320.08046 $1, 320.03(5) $0.50, 320.03(6) $1, 320.03(9) $1.50, 320.06(3)(b) $0.50, 320.04(1)(a) $2.50, 320.04(1)(b) $1 and 320.04(1)(c) up to $0.50, a total of $26.10 to $44.10 for 12 months; 24 months at the 2-year cumulative total under 320.07(2)(b) and 320.01(19)(b) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/Chapter320/All; FLHSMV fee schedule, https://www.flhsmv.gov/motor-vehicles-tags-titles/fees/

fees.name: Initial registration fee
fees.purpose: A one-time Florida fee when a car gets a new plate instead of one moved from a car you no longer have.
fees.dependsOn: whether you get a new plate or move a plate from a car you no longer have
fees.citation: F.S. 320.072(1) and (2)(b) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/320.072; FLHSMV fee schedule (Initial Registration Fee $225.00), https://www.flhsmv.gov/motor-vehicles-tags-titles/fees/

fees.name: License plate
fees.purpose: The metal plate itself, when a new one is issued.
fees.dependsOn: whether a new plate is issued
fees.citation: F.S. 320.0607(5) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/320.0607; FLHSMV fee schedule (Original/Replacement License Plate Fee $28.00), https://www.flhsmv.gov/motor-vehicles-tags-titles/fees/

fees.name: Plate transfer
fees.purpose: Moves your current plate to this car.
fees.dependsOn: whether a plate is moved from a car you no longer have
fees.citation: F.S. 320.0609 (2026) transfer fee $4.50 and up to $2 more, https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/Chapter320/All

fees.name: Temporary tag
fees.purpose: The paper tag you drive on until the plate arrives.
fees.dependsOn: whether a temporary tag is issued
fees.citation: F.S. 320.131(2) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/Chapter320/All

fees.name: New tire fee
fees.purpose: A $1 state fee for each new tire sold with the car, which pays for waste tire cleanup.
fees.dependsOn: how many new tires come with the car, up to five with the spare
fees.citation: F.S. 403.718(1) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/403.718

fees.name: Lead-acid battery fee
fees.purpose: A $1.50 state fee on a new lead-acid battery, which pays for water quality cleanup.
fees.dependsOn: whether the car comes with a new lead-acid battery
fees.citation: F.S. 403.7185(1) (2026), https://www.flsenate.gov/Laws/Statutes/2026/403.7185

states.name: Texas
states.scope: A Texas resident buying a passenger car or light truck of 10,000 pounds or less from a Texas dealer. Heavier vehicles, specialty plates, leases, new-resident fees and vehicles registered outside Texas are not covered.
states.note: For a new car the dealer collects 24 months of registration. The TxDMV pages read do not state the 24-month amount, so this schedule allows two years of the base and county fees.

fees.name: Title application
fees.purpose: Puts the car's ownership in your name in the state's records.
fees.dependsOn: your county: $33 in counties with air quality programs, $28 elsewhere
fees.citation: Transportation Code 501.138(a), https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.501.htm

fees.name: Registration
fees.purpose: The base fee that lets the car use Texas roads, paid into the State Highway Fund.
fees.dependsOn: the car's weight and whether it is new, which gets 24 months of registration
fees.citation: Transportation Code 502.252 ($50.75, 6,000 pounds or less), 502.253 ($54, 6,001 to 10,000 pounds) and 502.044(a-1) (24 months for a new car), https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.502.htm; TxDMV Texas Registration Fees, effective January 1, 2026, https://www.txdmv.gov/sites/default/files/body-files/FeeChart_1C.pdf; TxDMV Motor Vehicle Registration Manual (August 2026) 17.3 and 22.9, https://www.txdmv.gov/sites/default/files/body-files/Motor_Vehicle_Registration_Manual_Book_298.pdf

fees.name: Insurance verification fees
fees.purpose: Two $1 fees that pay for TexasSure, the state's insurance check, on a dealer sale.
fees.dependsOn: nothing; both apply to a dealer sale
fees.citation: Transportation Code 502.357(a), https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.502.htm; TxDMV Motor Vehicle Registration Manual (August 2026) 8.4, https://www.txdmv.gov/sites/default/files/body-files/Motor_Vehicle_Registration_Manual_Book_298.pdf

fees.name: Processing and handling
fees.purpose: Covers the state's and county's cost of processing the registration.
fees.dependsOn: nothing; it applies when registration fees are collected
fees.citation: Transportation Code 502.1911, https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.502.htm; TxDMV Motor Vehicle Registration Manual (August 2026) 1.1, Processing and Handling (P&H) Fee $4.75, https://www.txdmv.gov/sites/default/files/body-files/Motor_Vehicle_Registration_Manual_Book_298.pdf

fees.name: County fees
fees.purpose: Fees your county adds to registration for roads and bridges, transportation projects and child safety.
fees.dependsOn: your county ($0 to $21.50 a year in 2026) and whether the car gets 24 months of registration
fees.citation: TxDMV Texas Registration Fees, effective January 1, 2026 (county local fees, highest $21.50), https://www.txdmv.gov/sites/default/files/body-files/FeeChart_1C.pdf; Transportation Code 502.401, 502.402 and 502.403, https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.502.htm

fees.name: Inspection program replacement fee
fees.purpose: The state's share of the old inspection fee, now collected with registration: $7.50 a year, or $16.75 once for a new car's first two years.
fees.dependsOn: whether the car is new
fees.citation: Transportation Code 548.510(a) and (b), https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.548.htm; TxDMV Register Your Vehicle, https://www.txdmv.gov/motorists/register-your-vehicle

fees.name: Emissions inspection fee
fees.purpose: The state's share of an emissions test in the 17 counties that require one.
fees.dependsOn: your county and whether the car is used
fees.citation: TxDMV Register Your Vehicle ($2.75 Emissions Inspection Fee), https://www.txdmv.gov/motorists/register-your-vehicle; TxDMV Motor Vehicle Registration Manual (August 2026) 22.11, https://www.txdmv.gov/sites/default/files/body-files/Motor_Vehicle_Registration_Manual_Book_298.pdf

fees.name: Electric vehicle fee
fees.purpose: Paid by fully electric cars instead of the fuel tax they do not pay: $200 a year, or $400 for a new car's first two years.
fees.dependsOn: whether the car is fully electric, and whether it is new
fees.citation: Transportation Code 502.360(b), https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.502.htm; TxDMV Register Your Vehicle, https://www.txdmv.gov/motorists/register-your-vehicle

fees.name: License plate
fees.purpose: The metal plate a Texas dealer must issue on every retail sale.
fees.dependsOn: nothing; it applies to every retail sale
fees.citation: TxDMV Motor Vehicle Registration Manual (August 2026) 17.2 ("A Texas dealer must issue a $10 license plate for all retail vehicle sales"), https://www.txdmv.gov/sites/default/files/body-files/Motor_Vehicle_Registration_Manual_Book_298.pdf; Transportation Code 503.063(g), https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.503.htm

fees.name: Plate database charge
fees.purpose: A charge Texas lets the dealer add, up to $20, for entering your plate in the state's database.
fees.dependsOn: whether the dealer charges it
fees.citation: Transportation Code 503.0631(f), https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TN/htm/TN.503.htm

states.name: North Carolina
states.scope: A North Carolina resident buying a private passenger vehicle, or a pickup registered at up to 9,000 pounds, from a North Carolina dealer. The highway use tax stays with the tax check. Heavier trucks, specialty plates, leases and vehicles registered outside North Carolina are not covered.
states.note: G.S. 20-85 prints $25.00 for a plate transfer and a lien; NCDOT's 2024 fee adjustment lists $25.50. This schedule uses $25.50.

fees.name: Certificate of title
fees.purpose: Puts the car's ownership in your name in the state's records.
fees.dependsOn: nothing; it applies to every title
fees.citation: G.S. 20-85(a)(1), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_20/GS_20-85.html; NCDOT 2024 DMV Quadrennial Fee Adjustment (revised 5/9/2024), https://www.ncdot.gov/news/press-releases/Documents/2024-04-02-dmv-fees-increasing.pdf

fees.name: Lien recording
fees.purpose: Records your lender on the title when the car is financed.
fees.dependsOn: whether the car is financed
fees.citation: G.S. 20-85(a)(7), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_20/GS_20-85.html; NCDOT 2024 DMV Quadrennial Fee Adjustment, https://www.ncdot.gov/news/press-releases/Documents/2024-04-02-dmv-fees-increasing.pdf

fees.name: One-day title
fees.purpose: Prepares the title in one day, if someone asks for it.
fees.dependsOn: whether the one-day title service is used
fees.citation: G.S. 20-85(a)(12), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_20/GS_20-85.html

fees.name: Registration
fees.purpose: The yearly fee that lets the car use North Carolina roads.
fees.dependsOn: whether the vehicle is a passenger vehicle ($46.25) or a pickup, whose fee goes by its declared weight
fees.citation: G.S. 20-87(5), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_20/GS_20-87.html; G.S. 20-88(b) and (i) ($1.30 per 100 pounds from 4,001 to 9,000 pounds, plus $5), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_20/GS_20-88.html

fees.name: Electric vehicle fee
fees.purpose: Paid by plug-in cars instead of the fuel tax they do not pay: $214.50 a year for a fully electric car, $107.25 for a plug-in hybrid.
fees.dependsOn: whether the car is fully electric or a plug-in hybrid
fees.citation: G.S. 20-87(13) and (13a), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_20/GS_20-87.html

fees.name: Local vehicle taxes
fees.purpose: Yearly amounts your city, county or regional transit authority may add to registration: up to $30, $7 and $10.
fees.dependsOn: where you live
fees.citation: G.S. 20-97(b1), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_20/GS_20-97.html; G.S. 105-561(a), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/ByArticle/Chapter_105/Article_51.html; G.S. 105-570(a), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/ByArticle/Chapter_105/Article_52.html

fees.name: Plate transfer
fees.purpose: Moves your current plate and registration to this car.
fees.dependsOn: whether a plate is moved from a car you no longer have
fees.citation: G.S. 20-85(a)(4), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_20/GS_20-85.html; NCDOT 2024 DMV Quadrennial Fee Adjustment, https://www.ncdot.gov/news/press-releases/Documents/2024-04-02-dmv-fees-increasing.pdf

fees.name: Temporary tag
fees.purpose: The temporary plate you drive on until the registration is done; the dealer pays the state $1 for it.
fees.dependsOn: whether a temporary tag is issued
fees.citation: G.S. 20-79.1(a), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_20/GS_20-79.1.html

fees.name: County vehicle property tax
fees.purpose: Your county's and city's property tax on the car, collected with registration. It goes by the car's value and your local tax rates, and you can put it off 60 days with a limited registration.
fees.dependsOn: the car's value and your county and city tax rates
fees.citation: G.S. 105-330.4(a) and 105-330.5(a) and (a1), https://www.ncleg.gov/EnactedLegislation/Statutes/HTML/BySection/Chapter_105/GS_105-330.5.html; NCDMV Vehicle Property Taxes, https://www.ncdot.gov/dmv/title-registration/Pages/vehicle-property-tax.aspx
